title: BLACK LOTUS
description: A restaurant concept built around dining tables set inside black lotus forms, in a water garden. Guests arrive through a large lotus arch and pass a host desk beside the water. The hall is lit by a rain chandelier and gold detailing. By day the same space opens under a glass atrium with light stone, planting and a waterfall wall.
role: Concept design, creative direction and visual storytelling - Mariia Andriiuk.
